notes: Round 2: harder, transitive questions where grep/read is expensive AND completeness is hard to reconstruct, so accuracy and/or tokens should separate. Gold facts verified against the Django code graph. HT1 steers to a single behavioral_inventory call; HT2 is a wide transitive-impact question grep cannot answer; HT3 is transitive cross-cutting callers.

tasks.question: What is the COMPLETE set of functions that django.urls.base.reverse() reaches transitively -- its entire call closure, not just direct calls? List them.
gold_facts: it reaches get_ns_resolver, get_urlconf and get_script_prefix
it reaches URL-pattern helpers such as normalize, flatten_result and walk_to_end
the full closure is roughly 19 functions, spread across django.urls.base, django.urls.resolvers and django.utils

tasks.question: If you changed the behavior of django.urls.resolvers.get_resolver, roughly how many functions across the whole Django codebase would be transitively affected (they call it directly or indirectly), and which subsystems does that reach?
gold_facts: get_resolver is called directly by reverse and by the resolver-caching / URL-resolution machinery
because reverse and URL resolution are used pervasively, hundreds of functions (on the order of 400+) transitively depend on get_resolver
the affected functions span the URL layer, views, the admin (django.contrib.admin) and template/response handling
get_resolver is a central, high-impact function -- a change to it has a very wide blast radius

tasks.question: Which functions call import_string (from django.utils.module_loading), directly or transitively a couple of levels up? Roughly how many direct callers are there, and which Django apps use it?
gold_facts: there are roughly 40 direct callers, including AppConfig.create, django.contrib.auth.load_backend, get_hashers and get_password_validators
direct callers are spread across django.apps, django.contrib.auth, django.contrib.admin and django.contrib.messages
counting transitive callers (functions that call those callers) the number is substantially larger than the ~40 direct ones
